content: Naapahe tabe mease soo Te Pabe'e pihoo tu pupuamu oona kiba-matoo bika, mu oo pupua'amu mee nananeadu Peter-no, James, yise oo wannga'a John.
Togesoo ka Te Pabe'e nanesootuha'e oo koba atasoo tubuaga'a, yise pukwi oo namasooana tohawiyanega'a, yise patakwetseapunne.
Waha'yoo nanana Moses-no Elijah mee nananeadu yise oo-baa petuse oo-no yadoo'a.
Soo Peter yise meeoo ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Besa numme ka yaanona, ka oo u soomanakwe numme sakwa pahe tutukutsekoo tatza nobe mu matabuekukwu umme Elijah yise Moses.”
Togesoo oo yadooawunu oosoo koomeba umu-kooba habagahoo petu. Oonaga'yoona yise soo Te Naa mu yadooe, “E Besaa Tooa unu e soobedyana, besa e masoonammedu, mu sakwa besa a nakabetsea.”
Umu oo pupua'amu unu nakasui meatzedose oo-matoo nanesootuhigonno.
Soo Te Pabe'e umu-matoo mease yise mu tzamase meeoo mu netamma, “Yosuhoo gi suipana.”
Umu yise yaatu poonnese, soo Te Pabe'e suu'mu yise o.
Umu ka giba-ma'yoona sawekese soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “Gi haga tuukwepana ka yaanoko mu poonnepu ka e namayodase saa'a mu numu tuukwe.”
Numme Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu oo tubenga, “Ha'yoo unnena mu Jew numu nanesootuhi moohedu meeoo numu tunedyooe, ‘Soo Elijah mooe petugakwu’?”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo mu nanekwegea, “Oosoo yoo kaaheno manepunne. Elijah mooe petuse hemma e mooe nemabetseabekupu.
Mooasoo soo Elijah mu-baa petupu pana mu numu gi oo posopedakwadoo mee'e nu. Umu tooe how tooe Elijah sootunagapu oo batsapu. Umu nuka tuwazoo kusegeana e batsakwu.”
O'no numme oo nakatzimodu yise oo nakasopedakwadoo soo John Baa-wi Numu Matzakadu tookwa Elijah. Oosoo Te Pabe'e-kobenasoo nanekemmadu.
Soo Te Pabe'e bihoo numme pumme nakatzimodu-no ka numu ewa-kwi petugonno sumu'yoo nana ka Te Pabe'e-baa meatzedohoose mee oo netamma,
“U sakwa ka e tooa nanesootuhiku masoo ya'ehookayina sumutooe ka numu peta-kwitoo anoakayakwe yise ka baa-witoo wuehooyakwe tuwazoo. Oo manena masoo unu nuummaba wuma.
Nu ka umu ume nakatzimodu-baa a bi petuse sapa umu gi a mabesakute.”
Soo Te Pabe'e mee unakwe, “Mu gi e tubetse naka'oedyukute tooe nu wuna'me yaa mu-baa'yoose sapa. Mu sakwa e naka'oedyuku. Ka naatse yaa nu-baa bi petu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka tsoapa ka naatse-nagakoo nematzagakwunihoose, soo naatse yise besa mani.
Numme tunakatzimodu ka Te Pabe'e-no oetu watze nehanena mee unakwe, “How yise manena numme gi ka tsoapa nematzagakwuna'e?”

Soo Te Pabe'e mee ne netamma, “Mu gi oo nematzagakwuna'e mu ka gi tubetse tunaka'oedyukuna. Mu sakwa uga ka tubetse tunaka'oedyukuna tooe ka tuutsetse tunaka'oedyukuna sapa mu ka giba nooyooa tuunguna oosoo oo manikwu. Mu ka tubetse tunaka'oedyukuna tooe hemma tooe oo natuunguna o nageakwu.”
Ka saa'a Galilee-wi ne petugase soo Te Pabe'e mee ne netamma,
“Umu e wohomu nu-ma tzakaduse, e batsakwu yise waha tabe mease nu saa'a e ya'e-kwikoo namayodakwu.” Numme oo tunakatzimodu suda nakasokwama ka Te Pabe'e meeoo unakwe.

Soo Te Pabe'e numme pumme nakatzimodu-no ka Capernaum mee naneadu-wi petuga, soo pabatsekoo nanesootuhi nobe-witu tumasumudoodu ka Peter-baa petuoose mee oo tubenga, “Soo Jesus haa'a punno'o ka nanesootuhi nobe-witu tumanagayakwe?”

“Aha soo Te Pabe'e oo manekwu,” mee soo Peter oo nanekwegea. Ka nobe Te Pabe'e pukwe'yoo-kwi soo Peter egeagase soo Te Pabe'e mee oo mooe netamma, “Ha'yoo u oetu sooyugwe, Peter? Soo numu-kooba katudu puu gi pummesoo dooamu tunekwa'e, ka tu tumasumudookwi oosoo mu wakwawa'a suu'mu tunekwikwu haa'a?” “Mu wakwawa'a-makoo suu'mu,” mee'e soo Peter oo nekwegea.
“Nu tookwa ka Te Naa tooana gi tumanaga-wa'ne'yoo,” mee'e soo Te Pabe'e.

“Pana ta ka tumanagase umu gi taka sutakute.” Soo Te Pabe'e ka Peter pakwega tayase, mee oo netamma, “Ka banunadu-kwi petugase saa'a ka u mooe pakwe tutzatsebooana tupa-witu poonne ka u tumayu-ma saa'a ta-kooba tumanagahoo.”
